brief.headline: Odesa port strikes surge; FSB claims foiled Ural terror plot
brief.lead: Pro-Kremlin channels amplified a heavy wave of long-range strikes on Ukrainian ports, fuel and rail infrastructure while celebrating claimed frontline gains in Kharkiv region; the mood was overwhelmingly triumphalist (57% positive) except on Ukrainian drone attacks against Belgorod.

developments.title: Channels tout mass strikes on Odesa ports and Ukrainian logistics
developments.body: Channels claimed Russian precision weapons, Geran/Geran-4 and Lancet drones hit Odesa, Chornomorsk and Mykolaiv ports, fuel storage, rail and a Sumy compressor station; Two Majors claimed 145 missiles fired at Odesa region over 15 days and cited Ukraine downing 161 drones overnight. All figures channel/MoD-sourced and unconfirmed.

developments.title: FSB claims foiling terror attack on Ural facility
developments.body: At least five channels amplified an FSB claim that a plot against a Ural industrial/strategic facility was thwarted, with a Ukrainian-born suspect carrying a bomb reportedly shot while resisting arrest. Claim is FSB-sourced and unverified.

developments.title: Claimed capture of Volokhvske and Kharkiv-region advances
developments.body: Poddubny and Kotsnews claimed the North grouping took Volokhvske, plus Grafskoe and an advance toward Belyy Kolodets in Kharkiv region; other posts claimed gains near Konstantinovka, Novoselovka and Egorovka. Frontline sentiment jumped (net +89, a 56-point swing). All claims channel-sourced.

developments.title: Belgorod under sustained Ukrainian drone attacks, casualties reported
developments.body: The day's negative sentiment centered on Ukrainian strikes: Two Majors claimed 153 attacks on Belgorod region in one day killing 9 and wounding 77; Rybar cited nearly 3,000 Ukrainian drones against Russia last week. Casualty figures unconfirmed.

developments.title: Channels push narrative of cracking Western sanctions unity
developments.body: Rybar and Kotsnews claimed European nations are resisting new Russia sanctions and prioritizing national interests, framing weakening EU consensus on supporting Ukraine. Analytical framing, not a discrete event.

developments.title: Strikes on Ukrainian recruitment centers flagged as legitimate targets
developments.body: WarGonzo and Poddubny claimed Russian drones struck a Chernihiv military recruitment center (TCC), tying it to Kyiv's mass inspections of mobilization centers; Poddubny also framed a Sumy Epicenter mall hit as an ammunition storage site. Target justifications are channel claims.

narrative_watch.title: Ukrainian mobilization system 'collapsing'
narrative_watch.body: Kotsnews cited a Ukrainian ombudsman claiming society is ready for 'lynch mobs' against mobilization officials and only 10% of drafts follow procedure, part of a frame portraying internal Ukrainian breakdown.

narrative_watch.title: Poland false-flag drone accusation reframed as pretext
narrative_watch.body: Two channels echoed a Polish minister's warning of Russian false-flag drone operations, then suggested striking a Polish weapons hub — inverting the accusation into a target justification.

narrative_watch.title: Western anti-drone tech framed as cost-ineffective
narrative_watch.body: Two Majors mocked the US 'Buckler' missile and Lockheed's MORFIUS microwave drone as too expensive against cheap Shahed-136 targets, pushing a Russian cost-advantage narrative.

mood_lines.text: Uniformly triumphant (net +100) across 18 posts; heavy emphasis on Odesa ports, fuel, rail and recruitment-center strikes.
Sharp positive swing (net +89, up 56) on claimed Kharkiv-region captures and Konstantinovka clearing operations.
Most negative topic (net -62); focus on Belgorod casualties and near-3,000 drone claim, with defensive framing.
Mixed (net -27); optimism over cracking sanctions unity offset by anger at Moldova diplomat treatment and India protest.
Net positive (+40), boosted by FSB terror-plot claims and veteran/border-defender benefits; fuel shortage said to be easing.
Small volume (4 posts, net -100), directed at Ukrainian and Polish targets, not the Kremlin.

flag_texts.title: Frontline sentiment jumps 56 points to +89
flag_texts.body: A cluster of claimed captures — Volokhvske, Grafskoe, positions near Novoselovka, Egorovka and Konstantinovka clearing — drove frontline posts to near-uniform optimism, a sharp rise from prior days. All advances are channel/MoD claims and unverified.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation rumours surface across two channels
flag_texts.body: Two channels amplified mobilization themes: Kotsnews cited a Ukrainian ombudsman claiming 'lynch mobs' against draft officials, while Poddubny linked strikes on a Chernihiv TCC to Kyiv's inspections of mobilization centers — a coordinated 'Ukrainian draft in chaos' frame.

flag_texts.title: No criticism of Putin detected
flag_texts.body: The watchlist for criticism of Putin stayed quiet; the day's four 'criticism' posts targeted Ukrainian and Polish officials, with internal-Russia complaints limited to a Voronezh property case and air-defense losses near Melitopol.
